about.title: Camarillo Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Camarillo saw 3 traffic deaths alongside 303 injury collisions in the most recent reporting year, numbers that translate into real families facing sudden, unimaginable loss. Whether the collision happened along Ponderosa Drive, Santa Rosa Road, or the stretch of US-101 that runs through town, surviving family members are often left sorting through grief while also facing financial uncertainty. California law allows a spouse, domestic partner, or children to pursue a wrongful death claim, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain circumstances. These claims are separate from any criminal proceeding and exist to address losses like funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's guidance and companionship. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, that connects Camarillo families with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain options and next steps during an incredibly difficult time. There's no cost to speak with someone about what happened.

whyChoose.title: Why Camarillo Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Is Limited by Law
items.desc: California restricts who can file a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. An independent attorney can help clarify who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: A Firm Deadline Applies
items.desc: Wrongful death claims must generally be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity involve a much shorter window. Missing that deadline can end a family's ability to recover losses.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond Funeral Costs
items.desc: California law allows recovery for lost financial support and for the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance, not just burial expenses. An attorney can help identify the full scope of what a family may be owed.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation to determine standing.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Camarillo?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public road authority, may be involved given Camarillo's corridors like Santa Rosa Road, that deadline can be much shorter. It's important to act promptly to preserve your rights.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal case?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal charges that may arise from the same crash. Even if criminal proceedings are ongoing or have concluded, families can pursue a civil claim independently. This process focuses on compensation for the family's losses, not criminal punishment.
